75400.meaning1: intent on benefit; with a kind mind

examples.text: ten'ānusiṭṭho hitamanena tādinā, anāgate paramavisuddhadassinā, so nālako upacitapuññasañcayo, jinaṃ patikkhaṃ parivasi rakkhit'indriyo.

75401.meaning1: with a mass of accumulated merit

examples.text: ten'ānusiṭṭho hitamanena tādinā, anāgate paramavisuddhadassinā, so nālako upacitapuññasañcayo, jinaṃ patikkhaṃ parivasi rakkhit'indriyo.
ten'ānusiṭṭho hitamanena tādinā, anāgate paramavisuddhadassinā, so nālako upacitapuññasañcayo, jinaṃ patikkhaṃ parivasi rakkhit'indriyo.

75403.meaning1: with guarded faculties; looking after one's mind
75403.commentary: (SNPa) rakkhit'indriyo'ti rakkhitasot'indriyo hutvā. so kira tato pabhuti udake na nimujji udakaṃ pavisitvā sot'indriyaṃ vināseyya, tato dhammassavanabāhiro bhaveyyan'ti cintetvā. (APAa) rakkhit'indriyā gopitacakkh'ādiindriyā

examples.text: ten'ānusiṭṭho hitamanena tādinā, anāgate paramavisuddhadassinā, so nālako upacitapuññasañcayo, jinaṃ patikkhaṃ parivasi rakkhit'indriyo.

75404.meaning1: rolling the wheel; turning the wheel
75404.commentary: (SNPa) bārāṇasiyaṃ dhammacakke pavattite taṃ bhagavatā dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ, sammāsambuddho vata so bhagavā uppanno'ti-ādinā nayena jinavaracakkavattane pavattaghosaṃ attano atthakāmāhi devatāhi āgantvā ārocitaṃ sutvā.

examples.text: sutvāna ghosaṃ jinavaracakkavattane, gantvāna disvā isinisabhaṃ pasanno, moneyyaseṭṭhaṃ munipavaraṃ apucchi, samāgate asit'āvhayassa sāsane'ti.

75405.commentary: (SNPa) bārāṇasiyaṃ dhammacakke pavattite taṃ bhagavatā dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ, sammāsambuddho vata so bhagavā uppanno'ti-ādinā nayena jinavaracakkavattane pavattaghosaṃ attano atthakāmāhi devatāhi āgantvā ārocitaṃ sutvā.

examples.text: sutvāna ghosaṃ jinavaracakkavattane, gantvāna disvā isinisabhaṃ pasanno, moneyyaseṭṭhaṃ munipavaraṃ apucchi, samāgate asit'āvhayassa sāsane'ti.

75406.meaning1: bull among sages; foremost among ascetics
75406.commentary: (SNPa) gantvāna disvā isinisabhan'ti… nisabhasadisaṃ isinisabhaṃ bhagavantaṃ. (VVa) isinisabho'ti gavasatajeṭṭhako usabho, gavasahassajeṭṭhako vasabho, vajasatajeṭṭhako vā usabho, vajasahassajeṭṭhako vasabho, sabbagavaseṭṭho sabbaparissayasaho seto pāsādiko mahābhāravaho asanisatasaddehi'pi asampakampiyo nisabho… sīl'ādīnaṃ dhammakkhandhānaṃ esan'aṭṭhena isī'ti laddhavohāresu sekkh'āsekkhaisīsu nisabho, isīnaṃ vā nisabho, isi ca so nisabho cā'ti vā isinisabho. (VVa) isinisabhā'ti isīsu nisabha ājānīyasadisa.

examples.text: sutvāna ghosaṃ jinavaracakkavattane, gantvāna disvā isinisabhaṃ pasanno, moneyyaseṭṭhaṃ munipavaraṃ apucchi, samāgate asit'āvhayassa sāsane'ti.
buddho ca me isinisabho vināyako, adesayī samudayadukkh'aniccataṃ, asaṅkhataṃ dukkhanirodhasassataṃ, maggañ'c'imaṃ akuṭilam'añjasaṃ sivaṃ.

75407.meaning1: supreme sagehood; ultimate sainthood; (comm) understanding the path

examples.text: sutvāna ghosaṃ jinavaracakkavattane, gantvāna disvā isinisabhaṃ pasanno, moneyyaseṭṭhaṃ munipavaraṃ apucchi, samāgate asit'āvhayassa sāsane'ti.
sutvāna ghosaṃ jinavaracakkavattane, gantvāna disvā isinisabhaṃ pasanno, moneyyaseṭṭhaṃ munipavaraṃ apucchi, samāgate asit'āvhayassa sāsane'ti.

75409.meaning1: called Asita; by the name of Asita
75409.commentary: (SNPa) samāgate asit'āvhayassa sāsane'ti asitassa isino ovādakāle anuppatte.

examples.text: sutvāna ghosaṃ jinavaracakkavattane, gantvāna disvā isinisabhaṃ pasanno, moneyyaseṭṭhaṃ munipavaraṃ apucchi, samāgate asit'āvhayassa sāsane'ti.
sa pattapāṇi vicaranto, amūgo mūgasammato, appaṃ dānaṃ na hīḷeyya, dātāraṃ n'āvajāniyā.

75411.meaning1: abandoned right and wrong; given up good and bad
75411.meaningLit: abandoned what is and what is not to be done

examples.text: yassa ca visatā n'atthi, chinnasotassa bhikkhuno, kicc'ākiccappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.

75412.meaning1: like a razor's edge; like a sharp blade
75412.commentary: (SNPa) khuradhārā upamā assā'ti khuradhār'ūpamo. bhave'ti bhaveyya. ko adhippāyo? moneyyaṃ paṭipanno bhikkhu khuradhāraṃ upamaṃ katvā paccayesu vatteyya. yathā madhudiddhaṃ khuradhāraṃ lihanto, chedato, jivhaṃ rakkhati, evaṃ dhammena laddhe paccaye paribhuñjanto cittaṃ kiles'uppattito rakkheyyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (DNt) khuradhār'ūpaman'ti khuradhārānaṃ matthaken'eva akkamitvā gaman'ūpamaṃ.

examples.text: moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, khuradhār'ūpamo bhave, jivhāya tālum'āhacca, udare saññato siyā.

75414.commentary: (SNPa) jivhāya tālum'āhacca, udare saññato siyā'ti jivhāya tāluṃ uppīḷetvā'pi rasataṇhaṃ vinodento kiliṭṭhena maggena uppannapaccaye asevanto udare saṃyato siyā.

examples.text: moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, khuradhār'ūpamo bhave, jivhāya tālum'āhacca, udare saññato siyā.
yadūnakaṃ taṃ saṇati, yaṃ pūraṃ santam'eva taṃ, aḍḍhakumbh'ūpamo bālo, rahado pūro'va paṇḍito.

75416.meaning1: fact of making a noise; fact of echoing

examples.text: yadūnakaṃ taṃ saṇati, yaṃ pūraṃ santam'eva taṃ, aḍḍhakumbh'ūpamo bālo, rahado pūro'va paṇḍito.

75418.meaning1: is worthy of sagehood; merits sainthood

examples.text: yo ca jānaṃ saṃyat'atto, jānaṃ na bahu bhāsati, sa munī monam'arahati, sa munī monam'ajjhagā'ti.

75419.commentary: (SNPa) na kevalañ'ca arahati'y'eva, apica kho pana sa muni arahattamaggañāṇasaṅkhātaṃ monaṃ ajjhagā icc'eva veditabbo'ti arahattanikūṭena desanaṃ niṭṭhāpesi.

examples.text: yo ca jānaṃ saṃyat'atto, jānaṃ na bahu bhāsati, sa munī monam'arahati, sa munī monam'ajjhagā'ti.

75420.meaning1: observing the birthplace; noticing the source (of)

examples.text: yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham'upeti mando, tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, dukkhassa jātippabhav'ānupassī'ti.

75421.meaning1: bond of death; Māra's bondage; (comm) three levels of cyclical existence

examples.text: sammaddasā vedaguno, samma'd'aññāya paṇḍitā, abhibhuyya mārasaṃyogaṃ, na gacchanti punabbhavan'ti.

75422.meaning1: stilling of consciousness; subsiding of awareness

examples.text: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ viññāṇapaccayā, viññāṇ'ūpasamā bhikkhu, nicchāto parinibbuto'ti.

75423.grammar: pr 3rd sg, irreg form of vijānāti, trans (+acc)
75423.meaning1: comprehends; understands; recognizes; distinguishes; is aware (of)
75423.commentary: (SNPa) evaṃ tattha vijānatī'ti evaṃ tā vedanā vijānāti, tattha vā dukkhabhāvaṃ vijānāti.

examples.text: etaṃ dukkhan'ti ñatvāna, mosadhammaṃ palokinaṃ, phussa phussa vayaṃ passaṃ, evaṃ vijānati, vedanānaṃ khayā bhikkhu, nicchāto parinibbuto'ti.
etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ āhārapaccayā, sabb'āhāraṃ pariññāya, sabb'āhāram'anissito.

75425.meaning1: independent of all nutriment; detached from all fuel-sources

examples.text: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ āhārapaccayā, sabb'āhāraṃ pariññāya, sabb'āhāram'anissito.

75426.meaning1: dwelling in the formless realm; living in the immaterial state

examples.text: ye ca rūp'ūpagā sattā, ye ca āruppavāsino, nirodhaṃ appajānantā, āgantāro punabbhavaṃ.

75427.meaning1: conceiving a self; imagining an essence

examples.text: anattani attamāniṃ, passa lokaṃ sadevakaṃ, niviṭṭhaṃ nāmarūpasmiṃ, idaṃ saccan'ti maññati.

75428.meaning1: cessation of the sense of self; end of the individual identity
75428.commentary: (SNPa) sukhan'ti diṭṭham'ariyehi, sakkāyass'uparodhanan'ti sukham'iti ariyehi pañcakkhandhanirodho diṭṭho, nibbānan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: sukhan'ti diṭṭham'ariyehi, sakkāyass'uparodhanaṃ, paccanīkam'idaṃ hoti, sabbalokena passataṃ.

75429.meaning1: whatever one wants; what one desires
75429.commentary: (NIDD1) yadicchatī'ti yaṃ icchati yaṃ sādiyati yaṃ pattheti yaṃ piheti yaṃ abhijappati, rūpaṃ vā saddaṃ vā gandhaṃ vā rasaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbaṃ vā'ti, laddhā macco yadicchati.

examples.text: kāmaṃ kāmayamānassa, tassa ce taṃ samijjhati, addhā pītimano hoti, laddhā macco yadicchati.

75430.grammar: ind, adv, comp, irreg form of kiṃsu
75430.construction:
ka > ki + iṃ + su > sū
kiṃ + su > sū
75430.commentary: (NIDD1) kiṃsū bhavissāma ito cutāse'ti ito cutā kiṃ bhavissāma? (NIDD1) kiṃsū asissāmī'ti kiṃ bhuñjissāmi odanaṃ vā kummāsaṃ vā sattuṃ vā macchaṃ vā maṃsaṃ vā'ti, kiṃsū asissaṃ.

examples.text: kāmesu giddhā pasutā pamūḷhā, avadāniyā te visame niviṭṭhā, dukkh'ūpanītā paridevayanti, kiṃsū bhavissāma ito cutāse.
kiṃsū asissāmi kuvaṃ vā asissaṃ, dukkhaṃ vata settha kv'ajja sessaṃ, ete vitakke paridevaneyye, vinayetha sekho aniketacārī.

75431.meaning1: for which one criticizes oneself; for which one blames oneself
75431.commentary: (NIDD1) yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno'ti. yadan'ti yaṃ. attagarahī'ti dvīhi kāraṇehi attānaṃ garahati, katattā ca akatattā ca. kathaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca attānaṃ garahati? kataṃ me kāyaduccaritaṃ, akataṃ me kāyasucaritan'ti, attānaṃ garahati. (SNPa) yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno'ti yaṃ attanā garahati, taṃ akurumāno.

examples.text: ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho, yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.

75432.commentary: (SNPa) yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno'ti yaṃ attanā garahati, taṃ akurumāno.

examples.text: ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho, yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.

75433.grammar: pr, pass of limpati, irreg form of lippati, intrans (+loc)
75433.meaning1: is smeared; is soiled; is dirtied (by)
75433.commentary: (NIDD2) majjhe mantā na lippatī'ti majjhe mantāya na lippati, alitto anupalitto nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatī'ti, majjhe m'antā na lippati. (SNPa) nalippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro'ti so evarūpo dhitisampanno dhīro diṭṭhesu ca sutesu ca dhammesu dvinnaṃ lepānaṃ ekena'pi lepena na lippati. ākāsam'iva nirupalitto accantavodānappatto hoti. (SNPa) mantā na lippatī'ti paññāya na lippati.

examples.text: ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho, yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.

75434.commentary: (NIDD1) purakkhatā'ti dve purekkhārā, taṇhāpurekkhāro ca diṭṭhipurekkhāro ca… ayaṃ taṇhāpurekkhāro… ayaṃ diṭṭhipurekkhāro. tassa taṇhāpurekkhāro appahīno, diṭṭhipurekkhāro appaṭinissaṭṭho. tassa taṇhāpurekkhārassa appahīnattā, diṭṭhipurekkhārassa appaṭinissaṭṭhattā so taṇhaṃ vā diṭṭhiṃ vā purato katvā carati taṇhādhajo taṇhāketu taṇh'ādhipateyyo, diṭṭhidhajo diṭṭhiketu diṭṭhādhipateyyo, taṇhāya vā diṭṭhiyā vā parivārito caratī'ti, purakkhatā. (SNPa) purakkhatā'ti purato katā.

examples.text: pakappitā saṅkhatā yassa dhammā, purekkhatā santi avīvadātā, yadattani passati ānisaṃsaṃ, taṃ nissito kuppapaṭicca santiṃ.

75435.grammar: pr, irreg form of nirassati, trans (+acc)
75435.commentary: (SNPa) n'ādeti na nirassatī'ti rūp'ādīsu kañci dhammaṃ na gaṇhāti, na nissajjati.

examples.text: diṭṭhīnivesā na hi svātivattā, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ, tasmā naro tesu nivesanesu, nirassatī ādiyatī ca dhammaṃ.
na samesu na omesu, na ussesu vadate muni, santo so vītamaccharo, n'ādeti na nirassatī'ti.

75436.meaning1: seeing the pure; witnessing the faultless; (or) seeing clearly
75436.commentary: (NIDD1) suddh'ānupassī'ti pacceti ñāṇan'ti. yo suddhaṃ passati, so suddh'ānupassī

examples.text: passāmi suddhaṃ paramaṃ arogaṃ, diṭṭhena saṃsuddhi narassa hoti, ev'ābhijānaṃ paraman'ti ñatvā, suddh'ānupassī'ti pacceti ñāṇaṃ.

75437.meaning1: abandoning what was picked up; letting go what was grasped; (comm) (or) abandoning one's views
75437.commentary: (NIDD1) attañ'jaho'ti attadiṭṭhijaho. attañ'jaho'ti gāhaṃ jaho. attañ'jaho'ti taṇhāvasena diṭṭhivasena gahitaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ abhiniviṭṭhaṃ ajjhositaṃ adhimuttaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ. (SNPa) tassa pahīnattā attadiṭṭhiyā yassa kassaci vā gahaṇassa pahīnattā attañ'jaho

examples.text: na brāhmaṇo aññato suddhim'āha, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, puññe ca pāpe ca anūpalitto, attañ'jaho na'y'idha pakubbamāno.

75438.commentary: (NIDD1) accantasuddhī'ti na te vadantī'ti accantasuddhiṃ saṃsārasuddhiṃ akiriyadiṭṭhiṃ sassatavādaṃ na vadanti na kathenti na bhaṇanti na dīpayanti na voharantī'ti, accantasuddhī'ti na te vadanti. (NIDD1a) accantasuddhin'ti accantaṃ param'atthaṃ suddhiṃ.

examples.text: na kappayanti na purekkharonti, accantasuddhī'ti na te vadanti, ādānaganthaṃ gathitaṃ visajja, āsaṃ na kubbanti kuhiñci loke.

75439.meaning1: knot of grasping; bond of possession
75439.commentary: (SNPa) ādānaganthaṃ gathitaṃ visajjā'ti catubbidham'pi rūp'ādīnaṃ ādāyakattā ādānaganthaṃ attano cittasantāne gathitaṃ baddhaṃ ariyamaggasatthena visajja chinditvā.

examples.text: na kappayanti na purekkharonti, accantasuddhī'ti na te vadanti, ādānaganthaṃ gathitaṃ visajja, āsaṃ na kubbanti kuhiñci loke.

75440.commentary: (NIDD1) vivādānī'ti diṭṭhikalahāni diṭṭhibhaṇḍanāni diṭṭhiviggahāni diṭṭhivivādāni diṭṭhimedhagāni ca. (SNPa) tasmā vivādāni avītivatto'ti tena kāraṇena so diṭṭhikalahe avītivatto'va hoti.
75440.notes: The masculine gender is more common.

examples.text: paraman'ti diṭṭhīsu paribbasāno, yaduttari kurute jantu loke, hīnā'ti aññe tato sabbam'āha, tasmā vivādāni avītivatto.
na brāhmaṇassa paraneyyam'atthi, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ, tasmā vivādāni upātivatto, na hi seṭṭhato passati dhammam'aññaṃ.

75441.grammar: pr, comp vb, from na agāraṃ vasati, neg
75441.meaning1: does not live in a home
75441.commentary: (NIDD1) n'āgāram'āvase'ti sabbaṃ ghar'āvāsapalibodhaṃ chinditvā puttadārapalibodhaṃ chinditvā ñātipalibodhaṃ chinditvā mitt'āmaccapalibodhaṃ chinditvā sannidhipalibodhaṃ chinditvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā akiñcanabhāvaṃ upagantvā eko careyya vihareyya iriyeyya vatteyya pāleyya yapeyya yāpeyyā'ti, iti disvā n'āgāram'āvase.

examples.text: socanti janā mamāyite, na hi san'ti niccā pariggahā, vinābhāva'santam'ev'idaṃ, iti disvā n'āgāram'āvase.

75443.commentary: (NIDD1) patilīnacarassa bhikkhuno'ti. patilīnacarā vuccanti satta sekkhā. arahā patilīno. kiṃkāraṇā patilīnacarā vuccanti satta sekkhā? te tato tato cittaṃ patilīnentā patikuṭentā pativaṭṭentā sanniruddhantā sanniggaṇhantā sannivārentā rakkhantā gopentā caranti vicaranti viharanti iriyanti vattenti pālenti yapenti yāpenti, cakkhudvāre cittaṃ patilīnentā patikuṭentā pativaṭṭentā sanniruddhantā sanniggaṇhantā sannivārentā rakkhantā gopentā caranti vicaranti viharanti iriyanti vattenti pālenti yapenti yāpenti, sotadvāre cittaṃ… ghānadvāre cittaṃ… jivhādvāre cittaṃ… kāyadvāre cittaṃ… manodvāre cittaṃ patilīnentā patikuṭentā pativaṭṭentā sanniruddhantā sanniggaṇhantā sannivārentā rakkhantā gopentā caranti vicaranti viharanti iriyanti vattenti pālenti yapenti yāpenti. (SNPa) patilīnacarassā'ti tato tato patilīnaṃ cittaṃ katvā carantassa.

examples.text: patilīnacarassa bhikkhuno, bhajamānassa vivittam'āsanaṃ, sāmaggiyam'āhu tassa taṃ, yo attānaṃ bhavane na dassaye.

75444.grammar: pr 3rd pl of dahati, irreg form of dahanti, trans (+acc)
75444.meaning1: they consider as; they take as; they regard as
75444.commentary: (NIDD1) bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññam'aññan'ti .… te aññam'aññaṃ bālato hīnato nihīnato omakato lāmakato chatukkato parittato dahanti passanti dakkhanti olokenti nijjhāyanti upaparikkhantī'ti, bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññam'aññaṃ. (SNPa) bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññam'aññan'ti ayaṃ bālo ayaṃ bālo'ti evaṃ dve'pi janā aññam'aññaṃ bālaṃ dahanti, bālato passanti.

examples.text: te vādakāmā parisaṃ vigayha, bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññam'aññaṃ, vadanti te aññasitā kath'ojjaṃ, pasaṃsakāmā kusalā vadānā.

75445.meaning1: dependent on another; reliant on another's (view)
75445.commentary: (NIDD1) vadanti te aññasitā kathojjan'ti. aññaṃ satthāraṃ dhamm'akkhānaṃ gaṇaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ nissitā ānissitā allīnā upagatā ajjhositā adhimuttā. (SNPa) vadanti te aññasitā kathojjan'ti te aññam'aññaṃ satthār'ādiṃ nissitā kalahaṃ vadanti.

examples.text: te vādakāmā parisaṃ vigayha, bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññam'aññaṃ, vadanti te aññasitā kath'ojjaṃ, pasaṃsakāmā kusalā vadānā.

75446.grammar: pr, pass of hasati, irreg form of hassati, intrans (+instr)
75446.commentary: (NIDD1) so hassatī unnamatī ca tenā'ti. so tena jay'atthena tuṭṭho hoti haṭṭho pahaṭṭho attamano paripuṇṇasaṅkappo. atha vā dantavidaṃsakaṃ hasamāno.

examples.text: pasaṃsito vā pana tattha hoti, akkhāya vādaṃ parisāya majjhe, so hassatī uṇṇamatī ca tena, pappuyya tam'atthaṃ yathā mano ahu.

75447.meaning1: grounds for downfall; basis for ruin
75447.commentary: (NIDD1) s'āssa vighātabhūmī'ti sā tassa vighātabhūmi upaghātabhūmi pīḷanabhūmi ghaṭṭanabhūmi upaddavabhūmi upasaggabhūmī'ti, yā unnatī s'āssa vighātabhūmi.

examples.text: yā uṇṇatī s'āssa vighātabhūmi, mān'ātimānaṃ vadate pan'eso, etam'pi disvā na vivādayetha, na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti.

75448.meaning1: name of a wandering ascetic famed for debate
75448.commentary: (NIDD1) tesu tvaṃ kiṃ labhetha pasūrā'ti. tesu arahantesu khīṇ'āsavesu kiṃ labhetha paṭisūraṃ paṭipurisaṃ paṭisattuṃ paṭimallan'ti, tesu tvaṃ kiṃ labhetha pasūra. (SNPa) pasūrā'ti taṃ paribbājakaṃ ālapati.

examples.text: visenikatvā pana ye caranti, diṭṭhīhi diṭṭhiṃ avirujjhamānā, tesu tvaṃ kiṃ labhetho pasūra, yes'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītaṃ.

75449.commentary: (NIDD1) kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche'ti. kim'ev'idaṃ sarīraṃ muttapuṇṇaṃ karīsapuṇṇaṃ semhapuṇṇaṃ ruhirapuṇṇaṃ aṭṭhisaṅghātanhārusambandhaṃ rudhiramaṃs'āvalepanaṃ cammavinaddhaṃ chaviyā paṭicchannaṃ chidd'āvachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ kimisaṅghanisevitaṃ nānākalimalaparipūraṃ pādena akkamituṃ na iccheyya, kuto pana saṃvāso vā samāgamo vā'ti, kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche.

examples.text: disvāna taṇhaṃ aratiṃ ragañ'ca, n'āhosi chando api methunasmiṃ, kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche.

75450.meaning1: became confused; was baffled; was bewildered (about)
75450.commentary: (NIDD1) samuggahītesu pamoham'āgā'ti. yā sā diṭṭhi tayā gahitā parāmaṭṭhā abhiniviṭṭhā ajjhositā adhimuttā, tā'y'eva tvaṃ diṭṭhiyā mūḷho'si pamūḷho'si sammūḷho'si mohaṃ āgato'si pamohaṃ āgato'si sammohaṃ āgato'si andhakāraṃ pakkhando'sī'ti, samuggahītesu pamoham'āgā.

examples.text: diṭṭhañ'ca nissāya anupucchamāno, samuggahītesu pamoham'āgā, ito ca n'āddakkhi aṇum'pi saññaṃ, tasmā tuvaṃ momuhato dahāsi.

75451.commentary: (SNPa) na vedagū diṭṭhiyāyako'ti catumaggavedagū mādiso diṭṭhiyāyako na hoti, diṭṭhiyā gacchanto vā, taṃ sārato paccento vā na hoti. tattha vacan'attho, yāyatī'ti yāyako, karaṇavacanena diṭṭhiyā yātī'ti diṭṭhiyāyako. upayog'atthe sāmivacanena diṭṭhiyā yātī'ti'pi diṭṭhiyāyako.

examples.text: na vedagū diṭṭhiyāyako na mutiyā, sa mānam'eti na hi tam'mayo so, na kammunā no'pi sutena neyyo, anūpanīto sa nivesanesu.

75452.meaning1: who follows a view; who goes by belief
75452.commentary: (SNPa) na vedagū diṭṭhiyāyako'ti catumaggavedagū mādiso diṭṭhiyāyako na hoti, diṭṭhiyā gacchanto vā, taṃ sārato paccento vā na hoti. tattha vacan'attho, yāyatī'ti yāyako, karaṇavacanena diṭṭhiyā yātī'ti diṭṭhiyāyako. upayog'atthe sāmivacanena diṭṭhiyā yātī'ti'pi diṭṭhiyāyako.

examples.text: na vedagū diṭṭhiyāyako na mutiyā, sa mānam'eti na hi tam'mayo so, na kammunā no'pi sutena neyyo, anūpanīto sa nivesanesu.

75453.commentary: (SNPa) na mutiyā sa mānam'etī'ti mutarūp'ādi-bhedāya mutiyā'pi so mānaṃ na eti.

examples.text: na vedagū diṭṭhiyāyako na mutiyā, sa mānam'eti na hi tam'mayo so, na kammunā no'pi sutena neyyo, anūpanīto sa nivesanesu.

75454.meaningLit: not leaning on the former end
75454.commentary: (NIDD1) pubbam'antam'anissito'ti pubb'anto vuccati atīto addhā. atītaṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha taṇhā pahīnā, diṭṭhi paṭinissaṭṭhā taṇhāya pahīnattā, diṭṭhiyā paṭinissaṭṭhattā. evam'pi pubbam'antam'anissito. atha vā evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ na samannāneti, evaṃvedano ahosiṃ… evaṃsañño ahosiṃ… evaṃsaṅkhāro ahosiṃ… evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti tattha nandiṃ na samannāneti. (SNPa) pubbam'antam'anissito'ti atītaddh'ādi-bhedaṃ pubb'antam'anissito.

examples.text: vītataṇho purā bhedā, pubbam'antam'anissito, vemajjhe n'upasaṅkheyyo, tassa n'atthi purakkhataṃ.

75455.meaning1: lamentation and sorrow; wailing and grief
75455.commentary: (SNPa) paridevasokā sahamaccharā cā'ti paridevasokā ca maccharā ca kutopahūtā.

examples.text: kutopahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, kutopahūtā te tadiṅgha brūhi.
piyappahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, maccherayuttā kalahā vivādā, vivādajātesu ca pesuṇāni.

75456.meaning1: arisen from what is dear; born from the beloved

examples.text: piyappahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, maccherayuttā kalahā vivādā, vivādajātesu ca pesuṇāni.

75457.commentary: (NIDD1) kathaṃkathī ñāṇapathāya sikkhe'ti. kathaṃkathī puggalo sakaṅkho savilekho sadveḷhako savicikiccho, ñāṇ'ādhigamāya ñāṇaphusanāya ñāṇasacchikiriyāya adhisīlam'pi sikkheyya, adhicittam'pi sikkheyya, adhipaññam'pi sikkheyya (SNPa) kathaṃkathī ñāṇapathāya sikkhe'ti, ñāṇadassana-ñāṇ'ādhigaman'atthaṃ tisso sikkhā sikkheyyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: kodho mosavajjañ'ca kathaṃkathā ca, ete'pi dhammā dvayam'eva sante, kathaṃkathī ñāṇapathāya sikkhe, ñatvā pavuttā samaṇena dhammā.

75458.meaning1: based on perception; founded on recognition
75458.commentary: (NIDD1) saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā'ti. papañcāy'eva papañcasaṅkhā taṇhāpapañcasaṅkhā, diṭṭhipapañcasaṅkhā, mānapapañcasaṅkhā saññānidānā saññāsamudayā saññājātikā saññāpabhavā'ti, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā. (SNPa) saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā'ti evaṃ paṭipannass'āpi yā saññā, tan'nidānā taṇhādiṭṭhipapañcā appahīnā eva hontī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: na saññasaññī na visaññasaññī, no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī, evaṃsametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā.

75460.meaning1: each their own; everyone their personal

examples.text: sakaṃsakaṃ-diṭṭhiparibbasānā, viggayha nānā kusalā vadanti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ, idaṃ paṭikkosam'akevalī so.

75461.meaning1: pure in wisdom; with perfect understanding
75461.commentary: (NIDD1) saṃsuddhapaññā kusalā mutīmā'ti. suddhapaññā visuddhapaññā parisuddhapaññā vodātapaññā pariyodātapaññā. atha vā suddhadassanā visuddhadassanā parisuddhadassanā vodātadassanā pariyodātadassanā'ti, saṃsuddhapaññā. (SNPa) sabb'ev'ime diṭṭhiparibbasānā'ti sandiṭṭhiyā c'eva na vīvadātā. saṃsuddhapaññā kusalā mutīmā'ti sakāya diṭṭhiyā na vivadātā na vodātā saṃkiliṭṭhā'va samānā saṃsuddhapaññā ca kusalā ca mutimanto ca te honti ce. atha vā sandiṭṭhiyā ce pana vīvadātā'ti'pi pāṭho. tass'attho, sakāya pana diṭṭhiyā vodātā saṃsuddhapaññā kusalā mutimanto honti ce.

examples.text: sandiṭṭhiyā c'eva na vīvadātā, saṃsuddhapaññā kusalā mutīmā, na tesaṃ koci parihīnapañño, diṭṭhī hi tesam'pi tathā samattā.

75462.meaning1: internal peace; inner calm; tranquility within
75462.commentary: (NIDD1) ajjhattasantiṃ pacinaṃ adassan'ti. ajjhattasantiṃ ajjhattaṃ rāgassa santiṃ, dosassa santiṃ, mohassa santiṃ, kodhassa… upanāhassa… makkhassa… paḷāsassa… issāya… macchariyassa… māyāya… sāṭheyyassa… thambhassa… sārambhassa… mānassa… atimānassa… madassa… pamādassa… sabbakilesānaṃ… sabbaduccaritānaṃ… sabbadarathānaṃ… sabbapariḷāhānaṃ… sabbasantāpānaṃ… sabb'ākusal'ābhisaṅkhārānaṃ santiṃ upasantiṃ vūpasantiṃ nibbutiṃ paṭipassaddhiṃ santiṃ. (SNPa) ajjhattaṃ rāg'ādīnaṃ santibhāvena ajjhattasantisaṅkhātaṃ nibbānam'eva addasan'ti.

examples.text: idaṃ vadāmī'ti na tassa hoti, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ, passañ'ca diṭṭhīsu anuggahāya, ajjhattasantiṃ pacinaṃ adassaṃ.
vinicchayā yāni pakappitāni, te ve munī brūsi anuggahāya, ajjhattasantī'ti yam'etam'atthaṃ, kathaṃ nu dhīrehi paveditaṃ taṃ.

75463.grammar: ordin of dvi, irreg form of dutiya
75463.commentary: (NIDD1) ekañ'hi saccaṃ na dutīyamatthī'ti. ekaṃ saccaṃ vuccati dukkhanirodho nibbānaṃ. yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ. atha vā ekaṃ saccaṃ vuccati, maggasaccaṃ, niyyānasaccaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvācā, sammākamm'anto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhī'ti, ekañ'hi saccaṃ na dutīyam'atthi.

examples.text: ekañ'hi saccaṃ na dutīyam'atthi, yasmiṃ pajā no vivade pajānaṃ, nānā te saccāni sayaṃ thunanti, tasmā na ekaṃ samaṇā vadanti.

75464.commentary: (NIDD1) ete ca nissāya vimānadassī'ti. na sammānetī't'ipi vimānadassī. atha vā domanassaṃ janetī'ti'pi vimānadassī'ti, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā ete ca nissāya vimānadassī. (SNPa) ete ca nissāya vimānadassī'ti ete diṭṭhidhamme nissayitvā suddhibhāvasaṅkhātaṃ vimānaṃ asammānaṃ passanto'pi.

examples.text: diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, ete ca nissāya vimānadassī, vinicchaye ṭhatvā pahassamāno, bālo paro akkusalo'ti c'āha.

75467.meaning1: extreme view; over the top belief
75467.commentary: (NIDD1) atisāradiṭṭhiyā so samatto'ti. atisāradiṭṭhiyo vuccanti dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni. kiṃkāraṇā atisāradiṭṭhiyo vuccanti dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni? sabbā tā diṭṭhiyo kāraṇ'ātikkantā lakkhaṇ'ātikkantā ṭhān'ātikkantā, taṃkāraṇā atisāradiṭṭhiyo vuccanti dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni. sabbā'pi diṭṭhiyo atisāradiṭṭhiyo.

examples.text: atisāradiṭṭhiyā'va so samatto, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto, diṭṭhī hi sā tassa tathā samattā.

75468.meaning1: imagining one is perfected; overrating oneself
75468.commentary: (NIDD1) paripuṇṇamānī'ti paripuṇṇamānī samattamānī anomamānī'ti, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī. (SNPa) puṇṇo uddhumāto, tena ca diṭṭhimānena matto paripuṇṇo ahaṃ kevalī'ti evaṃ paripuṇṇamānī

examples.text: atisāradiṭṭhiyā'va so samatto, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto, diṭṭhī hi sā tassa tathā samattā.

75469.commentary: (NIDD1) sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto'ti. sayam'eva attānaṃ cittena abhisiñcati aham'asmi kusalo paṇḍito paññavā buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvī'ti, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto.

examples.text: atisāradiṭṭhiyā'va so samatto, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto, diṭṭhī hi sā tassa tathā samattā.

75470.meaning1: passion for one's own view; infatuation with one's own beliefs
75470.commentary: (NIDD1) sandiṭṭhirāgena hi te'bhirattā'ti. sakāya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhirāgena rattā abhirattā'ti, sandiṭṭhirāgena hi te'bhirattā. (SNPa) sandiṭṭhirāgena hi te bhirattā, yasmā sakena diṭṭhirāgena abhirattā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: aññaṃ ito y'ābhivadanti dhammaṃ, aparaddhā suddhim'akevalī te, evam'pi titthyā puthuso vadanti, sandiṭṭhirāgena hi te'bhirattā.

75471.meaning1: with an impure doctrine; (or) impure in character
75471.commentary: (NIDD1) sayaṃva so medhagam'āvaheyya, paraṃ vadaṃ bālam'asuddhidhamman'ti. paro bālo hīno nihīno omako lāmako chatukko paritto asuddhidhammo avisuddhidhammo aparisuddhidhammo avodātadhammo'ti

examples.text: sak'āyane vā'pi daḷhaṃ vadāno, kam'ettha bālo'ti paraṃ daheyya, sayam'eva so medhagam'āvaheyya, paraṃ vadaṃ bālam'asuddhidhammaṃ.

75472.commentary: (NIDD1) hitvāna sabbāni vinicchayānī'ti. vinicchayā vuccanti dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni. diṭṭhivinicchayā sabbe vinicchaye hitvā cajitvā pariccajitvā jahitvā pajahitvā vinodetvā byantiṃ karitvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā'ti, hitvāna sabbāni vinicchayāni.

examples.text: vinicchaye ṭhatvā sayaṃ pamāya, uddhaṃ sa lokasmiṃ vivādam'eti, hitvāna sabbāni vinicchayāni, na medhagaṃ kubbati jantu loke'ti.

75473.meaning1: sphere of harmony; where there is non-dispute
75473.commentary: (NIDD1) khem'ābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmin'ti. avivādabhūmiṃ vuccati amataṃ nibbānaṃ. yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ. etaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ khemato tāṇato leṇato saraṇato abhayato accutato amatato nibbānato passanto dakkhanto olokento nijjhāyanto upaparikkhanto'ti, khem'ābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ.

examples.text: appañ'hi etaṃ na alaṃ samāya, duve vivādassa phalāni brūmi, etam'pi disvā na vivādayetha, khem'ābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ.

75474.meaning1: seeing as sanctuary; regarding as safety
75474.commentary: (NIDD1) khem'ābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmin'ti. avivādabhūmiṃ vuccati amataṃ nibbānaṃ. yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ. etaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ khemato tāṇato leṇato saraṇato abhayato accutato amatato nibbānato passanto dakkhanto olokento nijjhāyanto upaparikkhanto'ti, khem'ābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ.

examples.text: appañ'hi etaṃ na alaṃ samāya, duve vivādassa phalāni brūmi, etam'pi disvā na vivādayetha, khem'ābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ.

75475.commentary: (NIDD1) khem'ābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmin'ti. avivādabhūmiṃ vuccati amataṃ nibbānaṃ. yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ. etaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ khemato tāṇato leṇato saraṇato abhayato accutato amatato nibbānato passanto dakkhanto olokento nijjhāyanto upaparikkhanto'ti, khem'ābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ.

examples.text: appañ'hi etaṃ na alaṃ samāya, duve vivādassa phalāni brūmi, etam'pi disvā na vivādayetha, khema-abhipassaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ.

75476.meaning1: led back to being; come back to existence; (comm) attached to being
75476.commentary: (NIDD1) bhav'ūpanītā'ti bhav'ūpanītā bhav'ūpagatā bhav'ajjhositā bhav'ādhimuttā'ti, bhav'ūpanītā. (SNPa) bhav'ūpanītā bhav'ajjhositā

examples.text: sīl'uttamā saññamen'āhu suddhiṃ, vataṃ samādāya upaṭṭhitāse, idh'eva sikkhema ath'assa suddhiṃ, bhav'ūpanītā kusalā vadānā.

75477.grammar: pr, irreg form of pavedhati, intrans
75477.meaning1: shakes; trembles; stresses; is agitated; is afraid
75477.synonym: kampati, calati, pariphandati, phandati, byathati, vikampati, vedhati, vedhatī, saṅkampati, sampakampati, sampavedhati, saṃkampati
75477.commentary: (NIDD1) pavedhatī'ti sīlaṃ vā vataṃ vā sīlabbataṃ vā viraddhaṃ mayā, aparaddhaṃ mayā, khalitaṃ mayā, galitaṃ mayā, aññāya aparaddho ahan'ti vedhati pavedhati sampavedhatī'ti, pavedhati.

examples.text: sace cuto sīlavatato hoti, pavedhatī kamma virādhayitvā, pajappatī patthayatī ca suddhiṃ, satthā'va hīno pavasaṃ gharamhā.

75478.grammar: pr, irreg form of pajappati, trans (+acc)
75478.commentary: (NIDD1) pajappatī'ti sīlaṃ vā jappati, vataṃ vā jappati, sīlabbataṃ vā jappati pajappati abhijappatī'ti, pajappati. (SNPa) pajappatī ca vippalapati

examples.text: sace cuto sīlavatato hoti, pavedhatī kamma virādhayitvā, pajappatī patthayatī ca suddhiṃ, satthā'va hīno pavasaṃ gharamhā.

75479.meaning1: blameworthy and blameless; faulty and faultless; objectionable and irreproachable
75479.commentary: (NIDD1) kammañ'ca sāvajj'anavajjam'etan'ti. sāvajjakammaṃ vuccati, kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ. anavajjakammaṃ vuccati, sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ. sāvajjañ'ca kammaṃ anavajjañ'ca kammaṃ pahāya pajahitvā vinodetvā byantiṃ karitvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā'ti, kammañ'ca sāvajj'anavajjam'etaṃ. (SNPa) sāvajjanavajjan'ti sabb'ākusalaṃ lokiyakusalañ'ca.

examples.text: sīlabbataṃ vā'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, kammañ'ca sāvajj'anavajjam'etaṃ, suddhiṃ asuddhin'ti apatthayāno, virato care santim'anuggahāya.

75480.meaning1: veneration for one's own teaching; honouring one's own doctrine
75480.commentary: (NIDD1) saddhammapūjā'pi panā tath'evā'ti. katamā saddhammapūjā? sakaṃ satthāraṃ sakkaroti garuṃ karoti māneti pūjeti ayaṃ satthā sabbaññū'ti, ayaṃ saddhammapūjā. sakaṃ dhamm'akkhānaṃ sakaṃ gaṇaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhiṃ sakaṃ paṭipadaṃ sakaṃ maggaṃ sakkaroti garuṃ karoti māneti pūjeti ayaṃ maggo niyyāniko'ti, ayaṃ saddhammapūjā.

examples.text: saddhammapūjā'pi nesaṃ tath'eva, yathā pasaṃsanti sak'āyanāni, sabb'eva vādā tathiyā bhaveyyuṃ, suddhī hi nesaṃ paccattam'eva.

75481.commentary: (KHPa) pūjaneyyabhāvaṃ upagatānaṃ pūjaṃ pasaṃsanto pūjā ca pūjaneyyānaṃ maṅgalan'ti āha.

examples.text: asevanā ca bālānaṃ, paṇḍitānañ'ca sevanā, pūjā ca pūjaneyyānaṃ, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

75482.commentary: (NIDD1) kappā'ti dve kappā, taṇhākappo ca diṭṭhikappo ca… ayaṃ taṇhākappo… ayaṃ diṭṭhikappo. na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā'ti. brāhmaṇo saṅkhāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā. sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā… sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā… yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti saṅkhāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā taṇhākappaṃ vā diṭṭhikappaṃ vā n'eti na upeti na upagacchati na gaṇhāti na parāmasati n'ābhinivisatī'ti, na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā. (SNPa) evaṃ pakappitaṃ diṭṭhiṃ purekkharānesu titthiyesu, na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā'ti gāthā.

examples.text: na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā, na diṭṭhisārī na'pi ñāṇabandhu, ñatvā ca so sammutiyo puthujjā, upekkhatī uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

75483.meaning1: following views; pursuing beliefs; adhering to theories
75483.commentary: (NIDD1) na diṭṭhisārī na'pi ñāṇabandhū'ti. tassa dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni abhabb'uppattikāni ñāṇ'agginā daḍḍhāni. so diṭṭhiyā na yāyati na nīyati na vuyhati na saṃharīyati na'pi taṃ diṭṭhigataṃ sārato pacceti na paccāgacchatī'ti, na diṭṭhisārī.

examples.text: na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā, na diṭṭhisārī na'pi ñāṇabandhu, ñatvā ca so sammutiyo puthujjā, upekkhatī uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

75484.commentary: (NIDD1) ganthā'ti cattāro ganthā, abhijjhā kāyagantho, byāpādo kāyagantho, sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho, idaṃsacc'ābhiniveso kāyagantho. attano diṭṭhiyā rāgo abhijjhā kāyagantho, paravādesu āghāto appaccayo byāpādo kāyagantho, attano sīlaṃ vā vataṃ vā sīlabbataṃ vā parāmasati sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho, attano diṭṭhiṃ abhiniveso kāyagantho idaṃsacc'ābhiniveso kāyagantho.

examples.text: vissajja ganthāni mun'īdha loke, vivādajātesu na vaggasārī, santo asantesu upekkhako so, anuggaho uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

75485.commentary: (NIDD1) pubbāsavā vuccanti atītā rūpa-vedanā-saññā-saṅkhāra-viññāṇā. atīte saṅkhāre ārabbha ye kilesā uppajjeyyuṃ te kilese hitvā (SNPa) pubb'āsave'ti atītarūp'ādīni ārabbha uppajjamānadhamme kilese.

examples.text: pubb'āsave hitvā nave akubbaṃ, na chandagū no'pi nivissavādī, sa vippamutto diṭṭhigatehi dhīro, na limpati loke anattagarahī.

75486.meaning1: who follows impulses; who goes after interests; who chases desires
75486.commentary: (NIDD1) na chandagū no'pi nivissavādī'ti. na chand'āgatiṃ gacchati, na dos'āgatiṃ gacchati, na moh'āgatiṃ gacchati, na bhay'āgatiṃ gacchati, na rāgavasena gacchati, na dosavasena gacchati, na mohavasena gacchati, na mānavasena gacchati, na diṭṭhivasena gacchati, na uddhaccavasena gacchati, na vicikicchāvasena gacchati, na anusayavasena gacchati, na vaggehi dhammehi yāyati nīyati vuyhati na saṃharīyatī'ti, na chandagū. (SNPa) na chandagū'ti chand'ādi-vasena na gacchati.

examples.text: pubb'āsave hitvā nave akubbaṃ, na chandagū no'pi nivissavādī, sa vippamutto diṭṭhigatehi dhīro, na limpati loke anattagarahī.

75488.commentary: (NIDD1) sakkhidhamman'ti na itih'itihaṃ, na itikirāya, na param'parāya, na piṭakasampadāya, na takkahetu, na nayahetu, na ākāraparivitakkena, na diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā sāmaṃ sayam'abhiññātaṃ attapaccakkhaṃ dhamman'ti, sakkhidhammaṃ. (SNPa) sakkhidhamman'ti sayaṃ abhiññātaṃ attapaccakkhaṃ dhammaṃ.

examples.text: akittayī vivaṭacakkhu, sakkhidhammaṃ parissayavinayaṃ, paṭipadaṃ vadehi bhaddante, pātimokkhaṃ athavā'pi samādhiṃ.
abhibhū hi so anabhibhūto, sakkhidhammam'anītiham'adassī, tasmā hi tassa bhagavato sāsane, appamatto sadā namassam'anusikkhe'ti.

75489.meaning1: removal of difficulties; dispelling dangers; epithet of Nibbāna
75489.commentary: (NIDD1) parissayavinayan'ti parissayavinayaṃ parissayappahānaṃ parissayavūpasamaṃ parissayapaṭinissaggaṃ parissayapaṭipassaddhiṃ amataṃ nibbānan'ti, sakkhidhammaṃ parissayavinayaṃ.

examples.text: akittayī vivaṭacakkhu, sakkhidhammaṃ parissayavinayaṃ, paṭipadaṃ vadehi bhaddante, pātimokkhaṃ athavā'pi samādhiṃ.

75490.meaning1: (of oral scriptures) is chanted; is recited; (comm) (or) is learned
75490.commentary: (NIDD1) anugīyantī'ti gīyanti niggīyanti kathīyanti bhaṇīyanti dīpīyanti voharīyanti. atha vā gīyanti gaṇhīyanti uggaṇhīyanti dhārīyanti upadhārīyanti upalakkhīyanti gadhitapaṭilābhāya.

examples.text: tattha sikkhā-anugīyanti, yāni loke gadhitāni, na tesu pasuto siyā, nibbijjha sabbaso kāme, sikkhe nibbānam'attano.

75491.meaning1: evil of greed; (or) greed and wrongdoing
75491.commentary: (NIDD1) akkodhano lobhapāpaṃ, vevicchaṃ vitare munī'ti. muni lobhapāpañ'ca vevicchañ'ca atari uttari patari samatikkami vītivattayī'ti

examples.text: sacco siyā appagabbho, amāyo rittapesuṇo, akkodhano lobhapāpaṃ, vevicchaṃ vitare muni.

75492.meaning1: with mind inclined to Nibbāna; intent on extinguishing; want to put out the fire
75492.commentary: (NIDD1) nibbānamanaso naro'ti… sabbaṃ taṃ visaṃyog'ādhippāyo nibbānaninno nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro abhisaṅkharotī'ti. evam'pi nibbānamanaso naro. atha vā sabbasaṅkhāradhātuyā cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan'ti. (SNPa) nibbānamanaso'ti nibbānaninnacitto.

examples.text: niddaṃ tandiṃ sahe thīnaṃ, pamādena na saṃvase, atimāne na tiṭṭheyya, nibbānamanaso naro.

75493.meaning1: swamp of sensuality; mire of sense desire
75493.commentary: (NIDD1) kāmapaṅko duraccayo'ti. kāmapaṅko kāmakaddamo kāmakileso kāmapalipo kāmapalibodho duraccayo durativatto duttaro duppataro dussamatikkamo dubbītivatto'ti, kāmapaṅko duraccayo. (SNPa) esā ca lokassa palibodh'aṭṭhena duratikkamanīy'aṭṭhena ca kāmapaṅko duraccayo'ti.

examples.text: gedhaṃ brūmi mah'ogho'ti, ājavaṃ brūmi jappanaṃ, ārammaṇaṃ pakappanaṃ, kāmapaṅko duraccayo.

75494.meaning1: difficult to transcend; hard to overcome

75495.grammar: prp of na vokkamati, neg, intrans (+abl)
75495.construction: na > a + vi + ud + kama + nta
75495.commentary: (NIDD1) saccā avokkamaṃ munī'ti. saccavācāya avokkamanto, sammādiṭṭhiyā avokkamanto, ariyā aṭṭh'aṅgikā maggā avokkamanto.

examples.text: saccā avokkamaṃ muni, thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo, sabbaṃ so paṭinissajja, sa ve santo'ti vuccati.

75496.grammar: ind, adv, from sabba, irreg form of sabbadhi
75496.meaning1: everywhere; in every way; in all respects
75496.commentary: (NIDD1) sabbadhī samo'ti sabbaṃ vuccati dvādas'āyatanāni… so sabbattha tādi sabbattha majjhatto sabbattha upekkhako'ti, anejo sabbadhī samo. (SNa) sabbadhī'ti sabbesu khandhaāyatan'ādīsu.

examples.text: aniṭṭhurī ananugiddho, anejo sabbadhī samo, tam'ānisaṃsaṃ pabrūmi, pucchito avikampinaṃ.

75497.grammar: pron, interr, irreg form of kati

examples.text: katī parissayā loke, gacchato agataṃ disaṃ, ye bhikkhu abhisambhave, pantamhi sayan'āsane.

75498.commentary: (NIDD1) ritt'āsanaṃ sayanaṃ sevato ve'ti. āsanaṃ vuccati yattha nisīdati, mañco pīṭhaṃ bhisi taṭṭikā cammakhaṇḍo tiṇasanthāro paṇṇasanthāro palālasanthāro. sayanaṃ vuccati sen'āsanaṃ vihāro aḍḍhayogo pāsādo hammiyaṃ guhā. taṃ sayan'āsanaṃ asappāyarūpadassanena rittaṃ vivittaṃ pavivittaṃ, asappāyasaddassavanena… asappāyehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi rittaṃ vivittaṃ pavivittaṃ.

examples.text: vijigucchamānassa yadidaṃ phāsu, ritt'āsanaṃ sayanaṃ sevato ce, sambodhikāmassa yath'ānudhammaṃ, taṃ te pavakkhāmi yathā pajānaṃ.

75499.commentary: (NIDD1) ritt'āsanaṃ sayanaṃ sevato ve'ti… taṃ sayan'āsanaṃ asappāyarūpadassanena rittaṃ vivittaṃ pavivittaṃ, asappāyasaddassavanena… asappāyehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi rittaṃ vivittaṃ pavivittaṃ.

examples.text: vijigucchamānassa yadidaṃ phāsu, ritt'āsanaṃ sayanaṃ sevato ce, sambodhikāmassa yath'ānudhammaṃ, taṃ te pavakkhāmi yathā pajānaṃ.
